The study is based on a comprehensive data set of hourly electricity prices from a major energy market, spanning a period of five years.Various statistical measures such as root mean squared error (RMSE), mean absolute error (MAE), R-squared value are used to evaluate the performance of the different machine learning models for forecasting. The results highlights the accuracy of different machine learning models during training and testing. The Various regression analysis methods were employed to forecast the price of the ISO New England electricity market using MATLAB software.

articleTitle: 5G Embedded Architecture for Medical Internet of Things (MIoT)
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Circuits, Power and Intelligent Systems (CCPIS)
abstract: The goal of human life is to stay fit and live a healthy life. As human life is aging their chances to get affected with diseases are higher. These diseases need to be cured through diagnosis and continuous monitoring with the help of better medical facilities with lower cost. MIoT infrastructure needs to be addressed through 5G technology which involves communication engineering and embedded system engineering to enhance that required data rate for MIoT applications. The developed system implementation with the 5G MIMO-OFDM on Zynq Ultra-Scale provides a data rate from 10 Gbps to 20 Gbps. In future work the system will be improved with multiuser MIMO (MU-MIMO).

articleTitle: Mho Relay Distance Protection Scheme using DWT Analysis under Symmetrical Fault Condition
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Circuits, Power and Intelligent Systems (CCPIS)
abstract: The utilization of renewable energy distributed generation has increased significantly in recent years, particularly with the use of solar and wind power sources that offer a clean and pollution-free form of electrical energy. However, proper protection coordination between conventional power systems and distributed generation is crucial to ensure reliable operation of interconnected power systems. The objective of this study is to propose a protection scheme based on DWT approach that can enhance relay tripping behavior and guarantee protection coordination between the two systems. The scheme involves the use of impedance calculation methods to detect faulted zones in the interconnected power system, both under normal conditions and during Line-to-Line Faults. To evaluate the effectiveness of the proposed protection scheme, simulations are conducted in the MATLAB R2020a/Simulink environment using distance protection.

articleTitle: Parametric and Non-Parametric Analysis on Mango Leaf Disease Detection via Optimized Hybrid Model
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Circuits, Power and Intelligent Systems (CCPIS)
abstract: Mango trees are an important fruit producer and are essential for preserving biodiversity. As a result, there is a growing movement to promote the adoption of sustainable agricultural practices in the production of fruit. Mango plants often struggle to produce enough fruit to meet demand because of disease. This study supports a hybrid classification approach for mango leaf disease detection. In this study, the preprocessing stage involved histogram equalization and contrast augmentation for the input image. A segmentation method employing the BIRCH technique will be applied to the preprocessed image. Several features are extracted in the subsequent phase, including color features, pixel features, center symmetric local ternary patterns (CSLTP), and center symmetric local derivative patterns (CSLDP). This study introduces a novel hybrid Deep-Maxout and Bi-LSTM leaf disease detection method. The proposed Self Upgraded Honey Badger Optimization (SUHBO) approach will be used to optimize the Bi-LSTM and Deep-Maxout weights in order to improve the performance of the proposed detection model. Finally, the performance is evaluated for parametric and non- parametric analysis.

articleTitle: Text Independent Speaker Recognition Using Fuzzy Based Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Circuits, Power and Intelligent Systems (CCPIS)
abstract: In the present scenario, the field of biometrics has arisen as an applied science with the goal of automatically measuring individuals' unique distinguishing traits and exploiting the data for forensic, security, and surveillance purposes. In text-independent speaker recognition, the speaker is recognized only on the basis of their voice signals, without reference to the content of the speech. Our solution to this is a fuzzy-based neural network [1], [15] architecture that learns feature vectors from training samples that contain MFCC. Three layers make up our suggested architecture: (i) the input layer, which accepts feature vectors as input; (ii) the hidden layer, which is in charge of employing k-means clustering to cluster the feature vectors; fuzzification; and computing effective information. and (iii) the output layer where the weighted information is converted into an objective function which is helpful for the unsupervised learning of the proposed network using the particle swarm optimization (PSO) [12]. The unknown parameters in the objective function to be optimized by PSO include the fuzzification parameters and the weights on the information computed at the hidden layer. In our work, we used a database with 100 speakers and 10 samples per speaker, and we created a novel architecture. 8 of these samples were used for testing, and the remaining 2 were used for training. After that, the trained network's performance was assessed using the test samples. In noise-free voice samples, our proposed network performed admirably with 87% accuracy, outperforming the Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM) at 86%.

articleTitle: Comparison analysis of DG-MOSFET without Stack configurations using HfO2 and Al2O3 taking DNA as Biosensor applications
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Circuits, Power and Intelligent Systems (CCPIS)
abstract: In this research, we investigated and related the effectiveness of two diverse setups for advanced DG MOSFET devices that can be applied as biosensors. We addressed the challenge of the short channel effect by employing a dielectrical modulation technique for label-free electrical detection of biomolecules such as protein, biotin, DNA, APTES. Both configurations utilized silicon as the channel material in the absence of a stacked model. Additionally, we evaluated the device's performance that has been analyzed based on various parameters, such as linearity, analog, sensitivity, and RF parameters, using DNA as the biomolecule in the cavity. The device structures were designed using Hf02 (with a dielectric constant of 25), Al2O3 (with a dielectric constant of 6.9), and SiO2 (with a dielectric constant of 3.9). The simulations were carried out using the 2D Sentrausu TCAD simulator, and the results were plotted using Origin Pro.

articleTitle: Utilizing IoT-Based Services to Reduce Financial Risks in the Banking Sector
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Circuits, Power and Intelligent Systems (CCPIS)
abstract: This paper presents a comprehensive proposal for the implementation of three micro services aimed at mitigating financial risk and enhancing security in the banking sector. By harnessing the power of IoT technology, these services offer innovative solutions that will revolutionize the industry. The first service focuses on lending vehicles, providing enhanced monitoring capabilities through the utilization of IoT devices. The second service emphasizes collateral monitoring for loans involving vehicles and real estate. Lastly, the third service ensures timely loan payments and control over collateral assets by employing various IoT technologies. Compliance with local regulations, borrower consent, and data security are crucial considerations for the successful implementation of these methodologies. Further research and refinement are required to seamlessly integrate these services into banking operations.

articleTitle: Unveiling the Depths: A Comprehensive Analysis of Natural Language Processing and Generative Adversarial Neural Networks for Text Generation Models in Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Circuits, Power and Intelligent Systems (CCPIS)
abstract: Deep Learning comes under Machine Learning that accomplishes more power and flexibility by learning to present different concepts or relations of real world to simpler concepts. We use Deep learning fundaments in this paper because it has massive amount of data that helps in innovations. We include these neural networks of deep learning because it comes with a high accuracy rate with lower computations. Natural Processing Language (NLP) and Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) are the methods that individually contribute to the text generation method. Although these are two different technologies giving the output for some common motive where Text generation plays a very important role in smart translations and dialogue systems. This review paper presents a model centered around text generation. This is done because combinedly we want to present what can be different approaches to look at a model like this. To solve the problem of unnecessarily used large texts, unsatisfactory feedback, NLP is used for text generation, GANN is used for text generation model, image generation etc. Finally, this is done to reduce time complexities, speed, efficiency in process because this is noticed that learning for a problem plays a vital role in education to enhance features.

articleTitle: Impact of Underlap/Overlap on Source Engineered Tunnel FET
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Circuits, Power and Intelligent Systems (CCPIS)
abstract: In this work the impact of overlap and underlap on double gate extended source tunnel FET (DG-TFET-ES) is analyzed. For this purpose, the transfer characteristics, energy band diagram and total current density of DG-TFET-ES simulated structure is compared with double gate tunnel field effect transistor-extended source overlap (DG-TFET - ES_OVL) and double-gate tunnel field effect transistor extended-source underlap (DG-TFET-ES_UDL) structures. The ATLAS simulator of SILVACO TCAD is utilized to perform all the device simulations. It is observed from the results that the ambipolar behavior of the TFET is improved when we are employing the underlap and overlap at channeldrain junction. Additionally, it has been found that the underlap structure has the narrowest tunneling barrier, making it the optimum choice for microwave applications.

articleTitle: OPC UA Implementation for Industrial Automation - Part 1: Evaluating the Performance of PubSub Model
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Circuits, Power and Intelligent Systems (CCPIS)
abstract: OPC UA (Open Platform Communications Unified Architecture) is emerging as the leading technology for facilitating machine-to-machine (M2M) and machine-to-cloud (M2C) communications in the field of industrial automation. It provides a unified protocol that enables seamless data transfer from sensors to the cloud, making it a widely adopted standard. With the introduction of Part 14: Publisher and Subscriber (PubSub) to the OPC specification, M2M communication with a shared information model becomes possible, offering scalability and efficiency in data exchange between machines. In this view, this paper aims to evaluate the applicability of the newly introduced PubSub model for industrial communications. Specifically, this research focuses on analyzing the performance of the OPC UA stack using two different operating systems: Embedded Linux (open source) and VxWorks (proprietary RTOS). The performance metric utilized is the Round-trip time (RTT), which measures the time required for data to complete one closed loop. The experimental results show that OPC UA PubSub exhibits robust performance, indicating its suitability for real-time industrial use cases.

Author Keywords: OPC UA (Open Platform Communications Unified Architecture)

articleTitle: Extractive Summarization on Twi Language Using Text-Rank and Fuzzy Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Circuits, Power and Intelligent Systems (CCPIS)
abstract: Twi is a dialect of the Akan language spoken in southern and central Ghana by several million people. About 80% of the Ghanaian population speaks Twi as a first or second language. Summarization is a basic natural language processing task, that is a step to further more advance tasks as well as an aid in reviewing information. This paper tackles the problem of summarizing Twi texts. Three extractive summarization techniques - TF-IDF, Text-Rank and Fuzzy C-means Clustering are implemented. We find that Text Rank performs best, while TF-IDF despite being fairly simple performs comparably well to Text Rank. Our work suggests that embedding based approaches are potent and further work should employ their use.

articleTitle: Low Frequency Noise Analysis in AlGaN/GaN HEMTs
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Circuits, Power and Intelligent Systems (CCPIS)
abstract: In this work, the low frequency noise characteristic of short channel AlGaN/GaN HEMT devices (Lg= 0.2 um) are shown. Low Frequency noise (1/f noise) analysis helps in estimation of the material and device quality, the trap/defect concentration and the reliability prediction of the GaN HEMTs. The drain current noise variation at different temperatures and different Al compositions have been shown. The Hooge mobility fluctuation model (HMF) has been used to investigate the noise performance of the device. The results are calibrated with recent experimentally measured data. The noise performance improves for lower Al composition and higher temperature. Hence a threshold should be maintained for the Al composition and operating temperature to get high drain current as well as low 1/f noise.

articleTitle: Investigation on the Effect of Process Conditions during Fermentation of Tea Manufacturing on Brightness of Tea Liquor
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Circuits, Power and Intelligent Systems (CCPIS)
abstract: As part of the tea manufacturing process, fermentation plays a significant role in determining the quality of the tea. An overall rating of tea quality is determined by factors such as brightness, body, taste, etc. In order to get preferred quality tea, it is essential to maintain process parameters like temperature and relative humidity at an optimal level. One of the major quality attributes of tea is brightness, and it is affected by the fermentation conditions. In this paper, the effects of fermentation conditions on tea liquor brightness are discussed. By using network-based instruments installed in a tea factory, process parameters are collected during fermentation. The corresponding tea quality along with its different quality attributes were collected from tea taster. For the study, process parameters were used as inputs, and brightness was used as an output. Firstly, the multivariate linear regression (MLR) method was adopted and 55.85% correct correlation was found for training data and 55.94% for validation data. This study found that the root mean square error (RMSE) for both training and validation is 0.2. After that, artificial neural network (ANN) was implemented to solve the stated problem. Models based on the back propagation-multilayer perceptron (BP-MLP) showed 95.53% correct correlation for training, and 95.47% for validation. RMSE found in this method is 0.079 for both training and validation. Therefore, the performance of the ANN model demonstrates how fermentation conditions affect tea liquor brightness as well as its potential for standardizing it numerically.

articleTitle: Leveraging Approximate 4:2 Compressors for Improved Performance in an 8-Bit Dadda Multiplier Design
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Circuits, Power and Intelligent Systems (CCPIS)
abstract: In recent years, the two primary design concerns in the digital world have been reliability and power consumption. In order to limit power usage new low-power architectural models were being introduced. The most basic components of computation are adders and multipliers, hence when constructing them low power consumption architecture must be considered. It is desirable to minimize the number of operations as this will lessen the dynamic power, which makes up a sizeable component of total power consumption. Approximate computation is one such ideal model for hardware implementation, and our approach proposes to build sixteen cases of approximate 8-bit Dadda multiplier to have a lower delay, area, and power dissipation. The application for image blending also uses the suggested multipliers.

articleTitle: Efficient Design and Implementation of Matrix Multiplication
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Circuits, Power and Intelligent Systems (CCPIS)
abstract: The semiconductor industry plays a crucial role in the design and manufacture of integrated circuits (ICs) used in a wide range of electronic devices. Matrix multiplication is of significant importance in various fields and applications as it plays a fundamental role in linear algebra, solving systems of linear equations, data analysis and machine learning, computer graphics and computer vision, network theory, graph algorithms, etc. This paper gives a thorough investigation into how the Wallace tree multiplier, Vedic multiplier, and parallel prefix adders might be combined to enhance matrix multiplication performance. These techniques contribute to achieving significant speed improvements and reduced and optimized resource utilization. Firstly, Ripple Carry adders, Kogge Stone adders, and Han Carlson adders have been designed and analyzed. After that, the Wallace tree multiplier and Vedic multiplier are designed using these adders. By combining both multiplier and adder, matrix multiplication designs, analyses the performance data, and interprets the results obtained from the experiments. Using the ISE Design Suite tools in Verilog, all circuits are created and simulations are run. The XC6SLX150T are the devices used for synthesis.

articleTitle: Formulation and Evolution of PV based Hybrid Electric Vehicle Charging Station Using High Gain Boost Converter
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Circuits, Power and Intelligent Systems (CCPIS)
abstract: The objective of this paper is to formulate and progress a PV based hybrid electric vehicle (EV) charging station. The proposed charging stations are powered by both PV and grid. The system is constructed to charge EVs directly with the existence of solar energy, and switch to grid power in the absence of PV source. When there are no EVs on the charging station, the system will also provide solar power to the grid, effectively functioning as a grid-tie solar power plant. The process uses an isolated high gain step up converter to increase the voltage at output side which is input to the grid-tie inverter. The converter output is controlled by implementing MPPT and PI controller. The adequacy of the established hybrid charging station is illustrated through various simulation results.

articleTitle: A Load Balancing Algorithm for Cloud-Fog-based IoT Networks using Bald Eagle Search Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Circuits, Power and Intelligent Systems (CCPIS)
abstract: The exponential growth of Internet of Things (IoT) usage causes the network congestion, delay-response while using cloud computing. Fog computing, a closer cloud service provider near edge network is popular for providing service to latency sensitive real-time data. The united cloud-fog model can be benefited to handle both real-time and latency-delayed services that minimizes cost and energy consumption. The large-scale real-time services to distributed and limited resource-based fog node lead a load balancing problem where nodes are unevenly loaded with underload or overload. Here a Bald Eagle Search based load balance algorithm is proposed that can evenly balance the load as well as optimally allocate resources of fog node. The performance results are evaluated and validated which reduces the energy consumption and increases makespan and percentage of resource utilization.

articleTitle: Design of an Arc-Shaped Slot Circular Patch Antenna for 5G Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Circuits, Power and Intelligent Systems (CCPIS)
abstract: This article presents an arc-shaped slot Circular Patch Antenna (CPA) suitable for 5G communications. The antenna is fed by coaxial probe feed and has a resonant frequency of 2.35 GHz, 2.59 GHz, and 3.36 GHz. The simulation is conducted using the HFSS software. The CPA has a substrate of 54.96 mm length and width, and a radiating patch with a radius of 17.88 mm. The antenna demonstrated good S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</inf>characteristic and impedance matching, with an S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</inf>value of −30.21 dB, −24.26 dB, and −16.09 dB with a gain of 0.47 dB, 4.92 dB, 1.07 dB respectively covering 2.3, 2.5, 3.3 GHz frequency band and an efficiency of 47%, 96%, 40%. The VSWR is almost ideal 1.06, 1.14, 1.37 and antenna provides a bandwidth of 60 MHz, 30 MHz, and 100 MHz for the above frequency bands to evaluate its suitability in 5G applications.

articleTitle: Modeling of Fractional Order PID Controller and Study the Application of Couple Spherical Tank Level Control
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Circuits, Power and Intelligent Systems (CCPIS)
abstract: In this topic a fractional order proportional Integral Derivative Controller is proposed to control the flow of liquid in a couple tank system which is very useful in petrochemical, water treatment and paper industries. Here spherical tank is used due to its higher storage capacity. Due to its variation in the surface it adds more non-linearity to the system. Finally a comparison is done between conventional PID and FOPID then rise time., peak time, settling time and peak overshoot is analyzed and better performance is measured out.

articleTitle: IoT Based Monitoring System for Mushroom Farming and Supply Chain Management
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Circuits, Power and Intelligent Systems (CCPIS)
abstract: More over 4/5 of the working population in Uttarakhand is employed in agriculture, making it completely dependent on the industry. A number of slopes have been converted into field terraces, which is a widespread practise in mountain agriculture. Some farmers turned to mushroom gardening as a side business to increase their income. A simple random selection process was used to pick 25 mushroom growers from the hilly areas of Nainital district for the study, which had a descriptive nature. Respondents to a closed-ended questionnaire were encouraged to provide information. Basic statistics including frequencies, percentages, and means were used to evaluate the acquired data. The aim of this study is to identify the current practices of mushroom growers in the region, consumer preferences and perceptions of mushroom quality and packaging, and the implications of the findings for the growers and other stakeholders. The results revealed that most of the respondents had limited knowledge of processing and packaging techniques to increase the shelf life of mushrooms. In addition, the transport cost from the hilly areas further added to the difficulties faced by the growers in selling their produce. The study recommends providing training and assistance to the growers in packaging and processing techniques to increase the shelf life of mushrooms. Policymakers need to provide better transportation facilities to the growers to enable them to sell their produce at fair prices. The study highlighted the necessity for mushroom growers to have canning and refrigerated facilities in the event of increasing production to prevent distressed sales and to raise public awareness of the nutritional value of mushrooms to encourage increased consumption.

articleTitle: Aluminum Gallium Nitride Power Heterojunction Bipolar Transistor Regimes for Power Electronics
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Circuits, Power and Intelligent Systems (CCPIS)
abstract: This paper presents numerical calculations and modeling of on-state and off-state characteristics of power heterojunction bipolar transistors with aluminum gallium nitride emitter and aluminum gallium nitride base of different composition. Breakdown voltages as high as 4.5kV are demonstrated and maximum current densities of 2×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sup> Amps per cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> are calculated. The effects of large acceptor ionization energies and of interface recombination are numerically evaluated. The effect of material composition on current-voltage parameters is systematically evaluated.

articleTitle: Tracking Control of an Inverted Pendulum System: A Novel Radial Basis Function Neural Network Supervisory Control Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Circuits, Power and Intelligent Systems (CCPIS)
abstract: The control of an Inverted Pendulum (IP) is one of the benchmark problems in control systems. It is very difficult to control due to its innate instability and extremely nonlinear properties. Here, a novel supervisory control method based on Radial Basis Function Neural Networks (RBFNN) approach aims to enhance the tracking performance of an IP system. The RBFNN is used as a dynamic compensator to improve the performance of the typical Proportional-Integral-Derivative (PID) controller. The network is trained to approximate the unknown nonlinear dynamics of the IP system. The corrective control signal is then produced by the trained network and added to the PID controller's output. An adaptive tuning algorithm is created to continuously update the RBFNN's parameters to achieve accurate tracking control. As a result, the system can instantly adapt to modifications in the dynamics of the plant. The effectiveness of the suggested approach in achieving reliable tracking control of the IP system is demonstrated by simulation results. When compared to the traditional PID and FUZZY-PID controller, the RBFNN supervisory control strategy significantly enhances the system's tracking performance with minimum overshoot and settling time. The method offers a promising framework for the control of complex nonlinear systems.

articleTitle: The Role of Artificial Intelligence in Mentoring Students
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Circuits, Power and Intelligent Systems (CCPIS)
abstract: A mentor is someone who can help, provide guidance, and support a mentee. The professionals or experts whose opinions and guidance we esteem, admire, and heed are mentors. With technological growth, AI mentors have become prevalent these days. In order to assist people, particularly students, in all facets of life, AI mentoring is a concept that combines AI with machine learning. Regardless of the subject, an AI chatbot can help its student. With AI chatbots, students can simply receive the answers to their queries without experiencing any reluctance, and they do not have to worry about making a mistake. They need not wait for their mentor to be liberated. AI mentors are accessible around-the-clock, among many other benefits. Patience and strong listening skills are two qualities that make a good mentor, and AI chatbots can assure that they will have both. They also listen to the mentee without passing any judgement on the question posed by the mentee or the feeling expressed. AI is the future, and AI mentors are an excellent way to achieve this. The present paper aims to showcase a review on Mentoring through Artificial Intelligence and how it has become a new technology for the future generations. It discusses the benefits of mentoring through AI. It throws light on the benefits of AI mentoring over the traditional method of mentoring and shows new and modern possibilities.

articleTitle: Adaptive Cubature Quadrature Kalman Filter in Square Root Framework for Nonlinear State Estimation with Unknown Measurement Noise Covariance Matrix
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Circuits, Power and Intelligent Systems (CCPIS)
abstract: An adaptive quadrature filter which is designed for nonlinear state estimation with unknown measurement noise covariance matrix has been formulated in this paper. The proposed filter is designed with the essential framework of square root version of Gaussian filters with Cubature Quadrature rule. During state estimation of nonlinear systems when the measurement noise covariance matrix remains unidentified the proposed filter ensures acceptable estimation performance by adapting the standard deviation of measurement noise at each time instant which also retains the numerical stability of the estimator. Efficacy of the proposed filter has been validated during state estimation of significantly nonlinear Lorenz attractors. Monte Carlo simulation indicates that the accuracy of the proposed filter is demonstrably superior to its competing algorithms and comparable with adaptive square root Gauss Hermite filter at considerably lower computation effort.

articleTitle: Regenerative System for Mountain E-Bicycle
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Circuits, Power and Intelligent Systems (CCPIS)
abstract: the most trending invention of this decade is the mountain E-Bicycle which is widely utilized all over the world. The driving distance of the bicycle is restricted up to energy storage of the inbuilt battery. The important feature of an E- Bicycle is being able to recover the energy. This paper presented here about the regenerating energy of an E-Bicycle where the bicycle does not need the electric energy to pass the specific distance because of the sloping side of the mountain. The regenerative unit helps to extend the range of the E-bicycle by charging the E-battery whenever the E-Bicycle comes down from the sloping side of the mountain. Regenerative System is the process of giving the energy from the motor into the battery while in the process of slopping. The presented paper describes the modeling of BLDC motor, Generator, Boost-Convertor and Capacitor using MATLAB-Simulink.

articleTitle: State Space Formation and Fuzzy Logic Control Based Performance Analysis of DC Motor Drives
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Circuits, Power and Intelligent Systems (CCPIS)
abstract: In this paper, a state space canonical form of DC motor is designed mathematically and then simulated in MATLAB Simulink. For a stable DC motor drive operation, a closed loop is required which accompany DC motor, controller, chopper and sensors. Further, in this manuscript a Fuzzy logic controller (FLC) is designed using fuzzy toolbox of MATLAB. Later, the canonical form of DC motor along with FLC and other major components of closed loop system a simulation is carried out with a load. Performance of this closed loop is observed on two cases. First, when the inner closed loop is unity and next is with complete closed loop system. Speed response for both cases is observed along with load. Time domain analysis parameters for these two cases are calculated and compared too. Comparison analysis shows the effectiveness and usefulness of the designed fuzzy logic controller with the closed loop DC motor drive.

articleTitle: Intrusion Detection System in IoT Smart city Environment using Tree-based Approach with Swarm-based Optimization for Multi-Step Cyber-Attack Dataset
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Circuits, Power and Intelligent Systems (CCPIS)
abstract: With the popularity of IoT technologies, security has become a significant concern. IDS is a crucial component that analyses IoT network activity and categorizes it as either normal or anomalous due to susceptible attacks from hackers. An IDS safeguards a system's availability, integrity, and confidentiality. Because of resource constraints and algorithmic complexity, traditional ML IDS have drawbacks when applied to IoT networks. A lightweight IoT IDS that is optimal, inexpensive, and can minimize the loss function. So, to find the optimal model parameter values of the ML algorithm, hyperparameter tuning is performed by using populationbased swarm algorithms. The swarm-based algorithms control the learning process to extract the ML algorithms' relevant parameters and ultimately learn. A comparative study between the proposed hyperparameter tuning and default parameters predictions is made. The experimental results confirmed that the suggested strategy improves the security of the IoT environment. This approach is evaluated and determined to be promising on the Multi-Step Cyber-Attack (MSCA) benchmark IDS dataset. Additionally, the suggested method outperforms standard Tree-based ML parameters in accuracy while achieving a satisfactory trade-off between effectiveness and productivity.

articleTitle: PV System Operation in Islanded Mode Based on Interleaved Boost Converter
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Circuits, Power and Intelligent Systems (CCPIS)
abstract: The rise in consumption of power by DC device in our house results in more AC to DC conversion loss. The solar power is a DC source which can be directly feed to these devices without conversion loss. This paper deals with solar power source integrated with battery energy storage system for DC load. The battery will supply power to the load under low irradiance condition to maintain constant voltage at the output. The solar PV output is given to the load by using interleaved Boost converter at 180-degree phase shift so as to reduce the input current ripple as well as increase the current rating for high power applications. The duty cycle of the converter is controlled by P&O MPPT algorithm. For charging and discharging of battery a bidirectional converter is used for a bidirectional power flow. The recommended model is simulated in MATLAB(Simulink) for full day data of variable irradiance condition.

articleTitle: Optimizing the 12T Hybrid 1-Bit Full Adder Circuit for Low Energy Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Circuits, Power and Intelligent Systems (CCPIS)
abstract: This paper introduces a novel design for a 1-bit 12T full adder, utilizing a hybrid approach. The design was implemented using Cadence Virtuoso software with 90-nm technology. The performance metrics, including propagation delay, power consumption, power delay product (PDP), and layout area, were assessed and compared against various established designs like transmission gate (TG) adder, complementary pass-transistor logic (CPL) adder, transmission function adder (TFA), hybrid pass-logic (HPL) adder, and others. When operating at a supply voltage of 1.2-V, the proposed design demonstrated notably low average power consumption (61.9 nW), coupled with moderately low delay (427.495 ns) and an impressively compact layout area (99.225 Comparative analysis with existing adder designs revealed substantial enhancements in terms of speed, power efficiency, and energy consumption.

articleTitle: Gallium Nitride/ Boron Nitride/ Aluminum Gallium Nitride E-Mode High Electron Mobility Transistor Modeling
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Circuits, Power and Intelligent Systems (CCPIS)
abstract: This paper presents numerical modeling of gallium nitride/boron nitride/aluminum gallium nitide E-Mode High Electron Mobility Transistors. Breakdown voltages of 4kV are calculated for technologically feasible AlGaN compositions. Various trade-offs between on-state current and other device parameters are calculated. Longitudinal optical phonon effect on on-state currents is numerically studied. The effect of material composition on current-voltage parameters is systematically evaluated.

articleTitle: Experimental Verification of Size Dependence of Intrinsic Bandgap of ZnO Nanoparticles
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Circuits, Power and Intelligent Systems (CCPIS)
abstract: This research paper presents experimental evidence demonstrating the relationship between the size of ZnO nanoparticles and their electrical bandgap (Eg), The authors employed the precipitation method to synthesize ZnO nanoparticles of varying sizes, and the intrinsic bandgap for each size was determined through UV-visible absorption spectra analysis. By combining the energy of light equation with the Lambert-Beer law, the square of the absorption value obtained from the spectra was found to be directly proportional to the energy of the incident light. The intrinsic bandgap of the material was then obtained by determining the x-intercept of the tangent at the steep section of the square of amplitude - energy plot. The experimental results revealed that the bandgap of ZnO nanoparticles increased as their size decreased. Additionally, the experimentally determined intrinsic bandgap values were compared with the numerically calculated values for further analysis.

articleTitle: Modified PV Panel Design Configurations for Enhancement of Panel Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Circuits, Power and Intelligent Systems (CCPIS)
abstract: This research work discusses the application of concept of the light reflection methodology to generate cost-effective extreme power generation under optimum photo voltaic (PV) panel space constraints. Multiple light reflector materials are arranged so that multiple input solar light intensities are initiated on the solar PV panel along with direct solar light intensity. Because of the multiple input light intensity reflections on the PV panel, substantial load current generation ensues, which was a key drawback of commercial PV panels. Also, this key action of multiple light input reflections on the PV panels enables the replacement of the application of large size of PV panels for adequate load current generation. This in turn offers enhanced panel efficiency in optimal space constraints results in the socio-economic benefit operation. Mirrors and aluminum foil are utilized as light reflecting materials due to their effective reflective coefficients. Therefore, multiple experimental investigations are carried out on minimum size of PV panels to verify the effective light reflection methodology and presented in this work. From the experimental investigations, a panel efficiency of 143.44% was noticed in optimal space constraints, which was the astonishing performance obtained using the concept of light reflection methodology

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of LSTM-MPPT using PI Controller under Dynamic Loading Condition
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Circuits, Power and Intelligent Systems (CCPIS)
abstract: The surge in renewable energy production in developing countries due to climate change has led to an increase in clean and green solar PV technology. However, the limited efficiency of solar PV modules has prompted researchers to focus on generating maximum power from them, particularly under partial shading conditions. The use of Maximum Power Point Tracker (MPPT) has become popular for this purpose. However, the performance of solar PV under partial shading conditions while maximizing power output is still an area that needs improvement. This paper proposes a Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) algorithm based on the Perturb and Observe (P&O) MPPT technique, with an improved search space. The proposed algorithm has been optimized using Fuzzy Fokker Planck solution and tested under four different concentrations of partial shading. The proposed algorithm has been validated using both hardware setup and simulation studies. Simulation results obtained using MATLAB show that the proposed MPPT technique offers higher and better performance in terms of Maximum Power Point (MPP) convergence and improves the efficiency of the proposed system under partial shading conditions, making the system more robust.

articleTitle: Comparative Study of AlGaN/GaN-Based Polarization Junction Super HFET
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Circuits, Power and Intelligent Systems (CCPIS)
abstract: The double-hetero GaN/AlGaN/GaN polarization junction (PJ) is a semiconductor structure designed to enhance the performance of RF (Radio Frequency) and power devices, primarily based on wide band gap materials like GaN (Gallium Nitride). By incorporating a GaN/ AlGaN/GaN structure, the device can create two-dimensional hole gas (2DHG) and two-dimensional electron gas (2DEG) at the upper and lower junctions, respectively. The PJ takes advantage of the inherent polarization properties of GaN and AlGaN materials. In AlGaN layer the Al composition is graded from 1% to 23% to improve the DC and RF characteristics. The composition grading improves the Gm by 37.6% and the output drain current by 51%. The cut-off frequency and maximum frequency also improve.

articleTitle: Polarization Converting Metasurface Inspired Circularly-polarized Antenna for OFF Body Communications
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Circuits, Power and Intelligent Systems (CCPIS)
abstract: This paper presents a novel polarization converting metasurface (PCMS)-inspired circularly polarized monopole antenna (MA) for 2.4 GHz off-body communication. The PCMS reflects a 90°-phase-shifted y-polarised wave upon the incident of an x-polarised wave from the monopole structure, and that combined with the direct wave generates circular polarisation (CP). The PCMS is designed by arranging 2×2 arrays of polarisation-converting unit cells (PCUC) on a metal-backed felt substrate. Initially, a conventional rectangular unit-cell (CRUC) is designed theoretically, and then, using CST Software, a square cut is engraved into the upper right corner of the CRUC to create the PCUC. Such a unit cell is chosen to attain −90° of reflected phase at 2.45 GHz for achieving right-hand circular-polarization (RHCP). Using the orientation of surface-current distribution and radiation patterns, the resulting state of polarisation is determined. In the operating band, an axial ratio (AR) bandwidth of 110 MHz is attained. The proposed metasurface improves the impedance bandwidth to 660 MHz, the peak gain to 6.5 dB, and the radiation efficiency to 68% in free-space (FS). In addition, the on-body (OB) performance is identical to that of free space due to the presence of metasurface, with a very low SAR value.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Gate-Stack 7 nm node Tri-gate FinFET for low power Application
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Circuits, Power and Intelligent Systems (CCPIS)
abstract: A novel 7 nm node gate-stack tri-gate n-channel FinFET with multiple oxide layers is explored in this paper. The device is designed and analyzed using technology computer-aided design (TCAD) simulations to examine the accuracy of results at lower gate lengths. The effect of oxide degradation for low-k dielectric is overcome by considering gate-stack oxide consisting of both low and high-k oxide layers. The proposed device shows suitable short channel electrical characteristics such as drain-induced barrier lowering (DIBL), subthreshold swing (SS), and on-current to off-current ratio (I<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">ON</inf>/I<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">OFF</inf>) even at such a lower gate dimension. An excellent I<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">ON</inf>/I<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">OFF</inf> ratio of 107 and SS value of 100 mV/dec are obtained with DIBL calculated to be 83 mV/V.

articleTitle: Effect of High Pass Filtering and Matched Filtering on Baseline Wander
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Circuits, Power and Intelligent Systems (CCPIS)
abstract: Optical Wireless Communication (OWC) channel can be the best suitable substitute of Radio Frequency (RF) channel. The high data rate transmission capability and reliable connectivity makes it eligible to support the IoT requirements. There are some unavoidable drawbacks associated with OWC channel in different environments. In this paper a drawback of indoor OWC channel has been discussed which is known as fluorescent light interference (FLI). While using the OWC transmission in indoor environment in form of LiFi, the background light coming from the other radiation sources present inside makes undesirable interference with the signal. The effect of this interference can be mitigated by applying various techniques. One of the techniques is the use of High Pass filter. As the FLI affects the low frequency components, the application of HPF with a suitable cut off frequency can be seemed to reduce the effect of FLI. But this HPF technique produces a form of Inter symbol interference (ISI) which is also known as Baseline Wandering (BW) that has a negative influence on the performance of the base band modulation technique. An alternative way to detect the signal can be the use of Matched Filter (MF) which always tries to match the signal with the original shape. In this paper the performance of a simple BPSK based system under FLI has been analyzed where the signal has been detected by using two different methods, that is by using HPF and by using HPF followed by MF. In both the cases the variation that causes baseline wandering has been found. The comparative studies of both the cases show that the system employing MF exhibits better performance as compared to the system with HPF. Also to verify the effect of this baseline wander on the system performance, the BER of both systems has been compared. By comparing the BER for the system with HPF and MF with the theoretical value of BER, it has been observed that the BER curve of the system with MF is closer to the theoretical BER curve. For the given scenario the minimum achievable BER for the MF based system comes down to a value about the order of 10-<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>at an SNR of 8dB whereas for HPF based system it comes down to an order of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>even at an SNR of 12dB, which proves that the MF based optical receiver performs better as compared to HPF based optical receiver.

articleTitle: Management of Overcrowding of Tourists at ‘Kainchi Dham Ashram’ in Uttarakhand Through Sensor Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Circuits, Power and Intelligent Systems (CCPIS)
abstract: The popularity of Neem Karori Maharaj ji's temple at Kainchi Dham in Uttarakhand has recently increased among people and there is mass increase of tourists at this place throughout the year. The aim of the present paper is to address the problem of over tourism at Kainchi Dham, identify the factors of tourist congestion and recommend tourist management tools for this divine place. The study proposes a sensor model to collate the footfall of tourist throughout the day and display it through a tourism app so that the tourists can observe, analyze and decide the suitable hour for their visit to ‘Kainchi Dham’. The footfall sensors can help to record and gauge the peak hours of the day and also the peak footfall days in a week. The aim of this paper is to explore the recent and emerging trends in information and communication technology (ICT) that could change the way tourism businesses and manage tourist influx of a popular tourist destination. The implementation of sensor technology and tools discussed in the paper will help to display real time foot count and prevent overcrowding and visitor congestion at a pilgrimage destination.

articleTitle: Broadband Inverted L-Shaped DRA for IoT Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Circuits, Power and Intelligent Systems (CCPIS)
abstract: This paper presents a broadband inverted L-shaped dielectric resonator antenna (DRA) designed to generate omnidirectional radiation for Internet of Things (IoT) applications. The antenna covers the frequency range of 2.4 GHz to 5 GHz, which encompasses the WiFi frequency range. The DRA offers an omnidirectional radiation pattern, making it suitable for various IoT applications. The antenna structure features an asymmetrical placement of an L-shaped dielectric resonator on a substrate, enabling efficient omnidirectional radiation. By optimizing the dimensions of the dielectric resonator and substrate, a compact antenna design is achieved. Simulated results demonstrate the excellent performance of the proposed antenna, showcasing omnidirectional radiation patterns within the frequency range of 2.4 GHz to 5 GHz. The compact inverted L-shaped DRA presented in this study provides a promising solution for efficient omnidirectional beam generation, making it suitable for advanced communication systems that require coverage in all directions.

articleTitle: Implementation of CSMA/CD and Link State Routing Protocols for Dijkstra Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Circuits, Power and Intelligent Systems (CCPIS)
abstract: In MATLAB, the Dijkstra method is used to implement the CSMA/CD and Link State routing protocols, which includes determining the shortest path over a given network architecture. In contrast to the Link State protocol, which is used for long-distance connections, CSMA/CD is designed for usage in local area networks. These protocols' capabilities, such as collision detection and link state updates, are included into a revised version of the Dijkstra algorithm. To evaluate the efficacy of the routing protocols, MATLAB is used to program a modified Dijkstra algorithm and to simulate the network architecture. Network engineers and academics can benefit from this implementation by testing and comparing the performance of various routing protocols in a variety of real-world settings.

articleTitle: Proximity Coupled Wideband Rectangular Microstrip Antenna for RF Energy Harvesting
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Circuits, Power and Intelligent Systems (CCPIS)
abstract: In this research, a proximity coupled rectangular microstrip antenna for the RF energy harvesting application is reported here. Here, the proposed antenna belongs to category of printed antenna, where, rectangular shaped patch is utilized as radiator. It is fed by the 50-Ω proximity coupled microstrip line, in between the FR-4 (ε<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">r1</inf>=4.4) and Rogers RT Duroid 5880 (ε<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">r2</inf>=2.2) substrate, having the overall dimensions of 60 (L<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">SUB</inf>) × 80 (W<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">SUB</inf>) × 2.4 (h<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">SUB-1</inf>= h<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">SUB-2</inf>) mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>. Then, parasitic patches & intuitive ground plane shaping method is incorporated out, for broadening the impedance bandwidth. The parameters such as impedance bandwidth, gain, efficiency, radiation pattern, and surface current distribution are reported & analyzed by using the EM solver CST microwave studio. It exhibits an impedance bandwidth of 277 MHz, a realized gain of 5.6 dB with antenna efficiency of 92% at a 2.4 GHz ISM Frequency Band (2.4-2.484 GHz). With the obtained results, the proposed antenna is a best candidate for ISM and can be even extended for the RF energy harvesting application.

articleTitle: Optimizing Power Output of Solar Arrays through Shifting Arrangement Reconfiguration
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Circuits, Power and Intelligent Systems (CCPIS)
abstract: In recent years, numerous solutions have emerged to decrease the adverse effects of partial shading (PS) concerning the functionality of photovoltaic (PV) systems. Enhancing energy capture is essential for optimizing the effectiveness of solar installations, a process affected by variables like the configuration of power electronic devices, environmental shifts, and system dimensions. While several configurations, including series, parallel, series-parallel, total-cross-tied, bridge-linked, and honeycomb, have been suggested, they can encounter limitations such as insufficient shading distribution, mismatch issues, and line losses. In response to these challenges, the concept of array reconfiguration has emerged as a promising solution. This paper delves into the present status and progress in the field of PV system reconfiguration, focusing on the introduction of an innovative approach known as Corner Shifting Arrangement (CS) reconfiguration aimed at Enhancing the efficiency of photovoltaic solar panel output. We conduct an extensive evaluation, comparing the efficiency of the newly Suggested physical reconfiguration with conventional array setups. This assessment includes an examination of parameters such as Mismatch Loss (ML),Fill Factor (FF), and Global Maximum Power (GMP).

articleTitle: An Approach to Detect CAD with Full Confidence Using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Circuits, Power and Intelligent Systems (CCPIS)
abstract: The main aim of this paper is to detect the Coronary Artery Disease (CAD) from the phonocardiogram (PCG) signals of human heart sounds using different machine learning (ML) techniques. In this proposed method, we separate CAD and non-CAD groups from PCG signals using different ML techniques with proper denoising. As de-noising is very important for PCG signals and ultimately affects the detection result, we first applied various wavelet-based de-noising techniques for non-CAD and CAD type heart sound signals (HSSs) to filter out the high-frequency components present. The Wavelet Scattering Transform (WST) has been used to extract many relevant features from de-noised signals in a single run, strengthening classification. Nowadays, ML plays a vital role in the health sector, and it has also influenced human life in this modern era. Various ML techniques have been investigated in this paper, and a system has been designed for the diagnosis of heart disease, with an emphasis on CAD for alarm generation. Classification of CAD was done by Naive Bayes(NB), K-Nearest Neighbour(KNN), Random Forest (RF), and Support Vector Machine (SVM) classifiers. Recall, precision, F1-Score, and accuracy were all used to evaluate the proposed models. In comparison to other models, the results based on the aforementioned measures show that SVM performed the best. SVM achieved 100% accuracy, 100% precision, 100% recall, and 100% F1-score. The results show that ML models have the ability to correctly identify CAD patients with appropriate denoising.

articleTitle: Sustainable Smart Society Development Based on Geo Sensitive Equality Using Vedic Structure, Artificial Intelligence, Blockchain and IoT
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Circuits, Power and Intelligent Systems (CCPIS)
abstract: The construction of a sustainable smart society based on the concepts of geosensitive equality through the use of Vedic Structure, AI, Blockchain, and IoT is proposed in this article. The idea imagines a society where social justice, environmental sustainability, and cultural preservation coexist in harmony with economic prosperity. The Vedic framework is put up as a blueprint for building a harmonious and all- encompassing society, with a focus on civic participation and teamwork. In this paper, it is suggested that emerging technologies like blockchain, IoT, and AI will make it possible to build a just and sustainable society. The idea emphasises the necessity of a cooperative strategy combining authorities, corporations, and communities to guarantee that the advantages of technological breakthroughs are spread fairly and that no segment of society is left behind. By utilising technology to address societal difficulties, this idea seeks to build a sustainable, intelligent society that upholds cultural values and fosters social fairness.

articleTitle: Topologies, Control, and Future Prospects of Hybrid Energy Storage Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Circuits, Power and Intelligent Systems (CCPIS)
abstract: Renewable energy resources (RES) are acquiring popularity in many industrial applications due to their non-depletion and clean qualities. Despite their numerous advantages, RES faces a number of challenges, such us their intermittent nature. To address this issue, the storage of energy produced by RES appears to be a promising solution. The energy and power densities of various types of energy storage systems (ESS) varies, with high energy density and high power density being the most common. However, none of these two forms of energy storage can fulfil all of the dynamic responsiveness, energy density, and power density criteria of integrated energy systems (IRSs) on their own. This work emphasizes the integration of HESS in IRSs and provides an overview of several employed topologies that include combinations of various energy storage technologies such as batteries, super capacitors, flywheels, and hydrogen-based storage. Furthermore, the control associated with each HESS presented topology is extensively discussed. This document is a useful resource for researchers wishing to gain an in-depth understanding of hybrid storage systems in IRSs.

articleTitle: Recent Scientific Achievements and Developments in Software Defined Networking: A Survey
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Circuits, Power and Intelligent Systems (CCPIS)
abstract: Application devices or application programming interfaces (APIs) that are connected with the channel's core embedded system and regulate congestion is known as software-defined networking (SDN). Architecture is the primary distinction among SDN and conventional connectivity. Traditional networking is hardware-based, whereas SDN is software-based. Compared to conventional networks, SDN is far more versatile since the routing protocol is software-based. Without adding extra equipment, it enables managers to handle the connection, alter customization options, supply resources, and boost internet bandwidth from a single user interface. There are a lot of developments in SDN which have enabled networking managers to get more freedom in selecting networking hardware, Adaptable network architecture and robust protection of the network. These new trends are reviewed in this article. We are hopeful that this chapter provides future insights in the research of SDN.

articleTitle: A Machine Learning-Based Algorithm for Early Detection of Sepsis in Hospitalized Patients: Development and Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Circuits, Power and Intelligent Systems (CCPIS)
abstract: Early sepsis detection improves patient outcomes and care. This research provides a Machine Learning (ML) system for hospitalized sepsis detection. Gradient boosting, an ensemble learning method, analyses patient data to detect sepsis early. A comprehensive electronic health record database, MIMIC-III, was used to design and test the algorithm. The algorithm's sepsis detection accuracy, precision, recall, F1 score, and ROC AUC were measured. The proposed approach was more accurate than traditional models. It accurately predicted sepsis patients and aid treatment. Real-time clinical decision-making is possible with the algorithm's fast prediction and training. It could revolutionize sepsis management by giving doctors a dependable early detection and intervention tool. The algorithm must be tested in various healthcare environments and patient demographics. To implement this technology widely, privacy and ethics must be addressed. The approach may improve patient outcomes and lower healthcare costs by detecting sepsis early.

articleTitle: A Comparative Analysis of Multicarrier Waveforms for Future Wireless Communications
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Circuits, Power and Intelligent Systems (CCPIS)
abstract: Beyond Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing, there has been a lot of study done since there is a requirement for enhanced waveforms in 5G networks. For 5G, many filtered multi-carrier transmission systems, such as filter-OFDM and filter bank multicarrier modulation, have been suggested, each with its own set of advantages and disadvantages. This article seeks to give a thorough comparative study of different waveforms, allowing for a comparative evaluation of their performance on an overall basis. The study comprehensively assesses various performance metrics, including peak-to-average power ratio, out-of-band leakage power, bit error rate over wireless channels, the impact of carrier frequency offset, and spectral efficiency. These findings will be useful in determining which waveform to use for the future generation of mobile communication systems.

articleTitle: White Blood Cell Classification Using Pre-Trained Deep Neural Networks and Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Circuits, Power and Intelligent Systems (CCPIS)
abstract: The accurate classification of white blood cells is crucial for diagnosing and monitoring various medical conditions. Traditional methods of diagnosis are expensive, time-consuming, and depend on specialists' expertise. Image processing-based techniques provide a faster and simpler approach to detecting abnormalities in white blood cells. In this study, a computer-aided diagnosis system was proposed that utilizes pre-trained networks for accurate classification of white blood cells. The dataset used in this study is sourced from Kaggle, and the classification process is performed without image segregation or feature extraction techniques. Pretrained series networks are employed for classification, and a classification accuracy of 99% is achieved using the Inception-ResNet-v2 network with the Adam optimizer. The comparative analysis aids in understanding the performance and suitability of different network architectures for white blood cell classification tasks. The results showcase the potential of the proposed computer-aided diagnosis system for accurate and efficient white blood cell classification, contributing to advancing the automation and reliability of white blood cell analysis and supporting improved disease diagnosis and monitoring.

articleTitle: Innovative Solutions for Water and Energy Challenges in Agriculture: A Review of Solar-Powered Irrigation Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Circuits, Power and Intelligent Systems (CCPIS)
abstract: The increasing population in developing countries is putting pressure on the demand for more food production, and modernization efforts are being made in the agricultural sector. In many developing countries, rainwater is heavily relied upon for agricultural practices, but the government and regional authorities have implemented various measures to enhance the accessibility of water for agriculture throughout the year. The majority of farmers depend on groundwater as their main water source, but the increasing prices of fossil fuels and inadequate electric grids in remote areas pose challenges to traditional water pumping methods. One solution to achieving sustainable and profitable agriculture is using renewable energy sources like solar energy for water pumping, which offers advantages such as reduced pollution and no fuel costs in the long term. Developing countries have widely adopted solar pumps, but the success of this technology depends on various elements like climatic conditions, crop type, groundwater availability, government support, and the cost and availability of conventional electricity.

articleTitle: A Smart and Secure Blockchain-Enabled Framework for Healthcare Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Circuits, Power and Intelligent Systems (CCPIS)
abstract: Traditional healthcare systems are based on patients approaching physically to get themselves registered and avail of medical assistance. Also, the voluminous data entry into the centralized databases makes the process slow and insecure. Further, the system is unscalable and limited in nature. There are many instances where rural and remote area citizens were denied access to healthcare facilities due to a lack of technological reach. The advent of IoMT has proved to be a boon to the healthcare industry because they have facilitated Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM) to store health information remotely in the form of Digital records or EHRs(Electronic Health Records). These devices are worn or implanted in the patients to get the data regularly and keep their health under scrutiny. However, these devices and the information they store are not secure. They are prone to malignant attacks, unauthorized tampering of health information, loss of vital and private information of the users, etc. Blockchain technology is an excellent solution to problems related to privacy and security, access and modification, control of information, forged information, and scalability. The blockchain offers decentralization of information distributed over a peer-to-peer network and stores data immutably. To a large extent, the problems currently faced in the healthcare industry are significantly mitigated. This paper proposes a smart healthcare system that uses IoMT devices coupled with blockchain in its back end. In addition, we have deployed a decentralized application to connect with patients remotely. We have proposed a method to run and deploy smart contracts using Ethereum and interaction between smart contracts and dApp. The results of the implementations are better than the existing systems regarding the security and privacy of patient data, eliminating intermediary costs while maintaining the quality of service through transparency and interoperability provided by Blockchain.

articleTitle: OPC UA Implementation for Industrial Automation - Part 2: Integrating PubSub Model with TSN
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Circuits, Power and Intelligent Systems (CCPIS)
abstract: The advent of Industry 4.0 has brought out a new era of automation, highlighting the importance of seamless integration and interoperability across diverse systems in industrial environments. To facilitate efficient and secure data exchange, the OPC UA (Open Platform Communications Unified Architecture) has emerged as a standardized communication framework in industrial automation. However, the traditional Ethernet-based infrastructure utilized for OPC UA cannot meet the stringent real-time requirements of time-critical applications. In industries relying on motion control applications like robotics or automated manufacturing, fast machine-to-machine communication is crucial. These applications demand precise and rapid data exchange to ensure the smooth and coordinated movement of machines. To address this challenge, it is crucial to assess the performance of the newly introduced Time-Sensitive Networking (TSN) implementation and verify its ability to meet the requirements for critical industry applications. In this view, this paper implements OPC UA by integrating the OPC UA PubSub (Publisher-Subscriber) model with TSN. TSN represents a set of standards developed to enable deterministic and low-latency communication over Ethernet networks. Experimental results provide clear evidence that the combination of OPC UA with TSN improves performance, making it well-suited for demanding real-time applications.

Author Keywords: Open platform communications unified architecture (OPC UA)

articleTitle: Prediction of Heart Attack and Death: Comparison Between 1 DCNN and Conventional ML Approaches
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Circuits, Power and Intelligent Systems (CCPIS)
abstract: Since heart diseases influence human life significantly, so rigorous investigations and experiments are needed for the treatment of patients in the early stage. Physicians could treat after identifying the heart diseases. After getting related information about the human body, immediate prediction of heart stock is awakened by the physicians for appropriate treatment and reduce the chances of a heart attack. Again, if the probability of death due to a heart attack is detected, then the treatment may help to recover the patients. To detect heart diseases, machine learning and deep learning approaches can be coded. In this study, two datasets are experimented with conventional machine learning algorithms and deep learning algorithms. One dataset is related to the prediction of chances of heart attack and another dataset is related to the prediction of death due to heart stock. Among all approaches, the one-dimensional convolutional neural network has been shown 99.9% accuracy of prediction. More experiments on heart diseases using different machine learning approaches can conclude the appropriate model for detecting heart diseases, whereas, in this study, the one-dimensional convolutional neural network has given the best performance.

articleTitle: Analysis of Multiple Imputation Techniques in Healthcare Data
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Circuits, Power and Intelligent Systems (CCPIS)
abstract: Clinical data are rapidly being mined to generate new medical knowledge with the aim of providing increased diagnostic accuracy, more customized treatment regimens, better clinical results, and more effective exploitation of health-related resources. The effect of missing information on the interpretation of statistics differs based on a number of variables, including the amount of missingness, the mechanism for handling missing data, and the technique used to deal with missing values. Therefore, missing data is one of the primary barriers to optimal knowledge elicitation from clinical data. In recent years, pattern-mixture model (PMM) has grown significantly with multiple types of missingness processes and it enables the analysis of incomplete longitudinal data. The root mean square error rate of PMM is around 0.092 which is very low compared to conventional methods like multi-chained equations (MICE) and K-nearest neighbor (KNN).

articleTitle: Principles and Potentials of F5G: The Fifth Generation Fixed Network
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Circuits, Power and Intelligent Systems (CCPIS)
abstract: In general, 5G is understood to be the fifth generation of mobile communications. However, there is also a fifth generation of wired communications which is led by the optical fiber technologies. This technology too has several attractive features like the wireless mobile 5G. In this article, we present the basic concepts of Fifth Generation Fixed Network (F5G). We show its characteristics and explain how it is going to change the communication landscape. We present the key benefits of F5G and show the main motivations behind its development. There are several applications of F5G and many emerging applications are also being introduced every year. Therefore, this newly developed technology has a lot of commercial importance in the modern world. In addition to the above, F5G is going to be one of the main rivals of 5G in the fixed environment. It is expected that F5G will outperform all its contemporary access area technologies in the fixed domain in the next few years. In this article, we briefly present its applications and future economic prospects.

articleTitle: Generative Chatbot Adaptation for Odia Language: A Critical Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Circuits, Power and Intelligent Systems (CCPIS)
abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have gained significant attention in the field of Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Artificial Intelligence (AI) due to their ability to generate human-like text and facilitate conversational interactions. However, the majority of LLMs are majorly developed for English, limiting their accessibility and effectiveness for non-English speaking populations. In India, where only 10% of the population is proficient in English, the need for LLM models adapted to regional languages becomes crucial. This research paper focuses on the adaptability of LLMs to the Odia language, spoken by approximately 50 million people in India. With a primary objective to cater to the Odia-speaking community, we aim to evaluate existing LLM models such as ChatGPT, and Olive, an instruction following Odia LLM, specifically in the context of generating conversational outputs in Odia. We employ a critical evaluation approach to assess the performance, language understanding, and response generation capabilities of the LLM models for the Odia language. By conducting experiments and comparative analysis, we seek to determine the strengths, weaknesses, and potential areas of improvement for the existing LLM models. Our findings will contribute to the development of more effective and contextually accurate generative chatbots for the Odia language, enabling better communication and accessibility for the Odia-speaking population.

articleTitle: Prediction of Covid-19 using Machine Learning and Deep Learning approaches: A data driven study
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Circuits, Power and Intelligent Systems (CCPIS)
abstract: COVID-19 is generated by the SARS-CoV2 virus, which has caused an outbreak around the world. Since 2020, it has been labeled a pandemic. Due to the daily growth in the number of cases, this takes time for demonstrating the laboratory data, and as a result, treatment and resource limits have emerged. Because of such limitations the necessity for making decisions using clinical data with prognostic algorithms has emerged. Forecasting algorithms could positively relieve the pressure on healthcare systems by correctly identifying the disease. We employ the following machine learning models in this research: RF, SVM, hybrid RF-SVM and deep learning: ANN, CNN, LSTM, CNN-LSTM models and Laboratory data is being used to develop clinical forecasting models that will help medical professionals to figure out the patients that are most likely to develop COVID-19. Our models' prediction ability is measured using recall, F1-score, precision, accuracy and AUC scores. The models were verified using train test method and cross validation strategy. The assessment shows that most of our prediction models can reliably identify patients with COVID-19 disease, amidst the hybrid CNN-LSTM model outperforming the others with an accuracy of 89.5 percent,0.93 F1-score, 0.91 in precision,0.97 in recall, and AUC of 0.70, whereas among the machine learning models the hybrid ensemble outperforms other ML models with an accuracy of 92%. Predictive models obtained from laboratory findings have been found to be successful in predicting COVID-19 infection, which can help medical experts administer resources more effectively.

articleTitle: Review on Grid Integration of Renewable Energy Resources to Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Circuits, Power and Intelligent Systems (CCPIS)
abstract: In the existing scenario, renewable electricity technology and integration into the grid are having a large effect on system protection and stability. So, the grid integration requirements have been the principal fear as renewable sources which includes wind and solar PV have occurred as an alternative to traditional electricity technology. There are numerous troubles associated with grid integration. Here, electricity is the principal challenge of renewable strength integration. A few apprehensions are 1) voltage and frequency changes, which continue to be taking place because of the uncontrollable renewable sources. 2) Harmonics which can be offered with the aid of using electricity digital equipment has been utilized in renewable electricity technology. In this survey, numerous strategies which can be used to reduce electricity troubles and electric-powered equipment and the effect of electricity because of renewable sources integration have been discussed.

articleTitle: Object Detection for Video Surveillance Using Edge-Cloud Collaboration
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Circuits, Power and Intelligent Systems (CCPIS)
abstract: Road safety and emergency response are greatly improved by accurate and prompt accident detection. This study describes a novel method for accident detection that makes use of a Telegram bot for communication and a Raspberry Pi as an edge device. Based on video feeds, the system uses computer vision techniques, notably the YOLOv3 algorithm, to detect accidents in real-time. The system instantly notifies chosen receivers, such as emergency services or worried parties, via the Telegram bot when an accident is detected. Results from experiments show how well the system performs in terms of reliably recognizing accidents and sending out timely alerts. The system's real-time execution, useful applications, and highlighted restrictions offer insightful information for upcoming improvements. This paper offers a scalable and flexible solution for enhancing emergency response and road safety, which advances the field of accident detection and management.

articleTitle: A Simple Translation System Using a Machine Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Circuits, Power and Intelligent Systems (CCPIS)
abstract: Despite the fact that machine translation has advanced greatly in recent years, it continues to struggle with issues including vague rules, missing data, and the increase in wrong translation order. Construct intricate mappings between functions, inputs, and outputs, and successfully troubleshoot translation system issues. The fundamentals and illustrative models of deep learning and machine learning are introduced. In this proposal examines the principles, frameworks, and models of neural model-based machine translation systems. The design of preprocessing and coding modules in accordance with translation requirements and present a machine learning-based translation system.
