To produce a user-friendly programme, capabilities like text translation, text synthesis, text-from-image extraction, text-to-speech conversion, and many more must all be incorporated. The main objective is to convert the text that has been extracted from a picture that the user has provided into speech. Giving visually impaired persons a helpful mp3 format is one of our objectives.

articleTitle: Power Quality Disturbances Mitigation Techniques for DFIG-based Wind Farm: A Review
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Circuits, Power and Intelligent Systems (CCPIS)
abstract: Power quality disturbances pose significant challenges to the operation and performance of wind energy conversion systems (WECS). This research paper presents a comprehensive review of the mitigation techniques for power quality disturbances in Doubly Fed Induction Generator (DFIG)-based wind farms. The paper discusses the various types of power quality disturbances commonly encountered in DFIG-based wind farms and provides an overview of the existing mitigation techniques. It examines control strategies, power electronics devices, and grid integration methods employed to mitigate power quality disturbances. The review also highlights the strengths and limitations of each technique and identifies potential areas for future research. Keywords: Power quality disturbances, DFIG, wind farm, mitigation techniques, control strategies, power electronics devices, grid integration, review.

articleTitle: Plant Leaf Disease Detection Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Circuits, Power and Intelligent Systems (CCPIS)
abstract: Due to our country's rapid population growth and rising food demand, the productivity of the agricultural sector is crucial to the Indian economy. As a result, crop yield needs to increase. Low agricultural output is significantly impacted by the presence of bacterial, viral, and fungal diseases. Plant diseases can be stopped with the help of detection techniques. As a result of their primary attention on the data themselves and emphasis on task outcomes, we use modern ways to deal with this like ML algorithms. In this paper, we not only discussed the detection of disease but along with that, we also studied other CNN architectures. It was discovered through this study endeavor that convolutional neural networks concentrate on offering high accuracy and detecting more crop illnesses.

articleTitle: Novel Optimization Techniques and Controllers for Power Quality Improvement
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Circuits, Power and Intelligent Systems (CCPIS)
abstract: This paper provides a thorough analysis of the optimization methods used to enhance electrical system power quality. In order to guarantee the dependable and effective operation of diverse electrical devices and equipment, power quality is essential. In order to improve system performance and manage power quality issues, optimization techniques have become effective tools. This review looks at a variety of optimization methods, such as Gravitation Search Algorithm (GSA), Black widow optimization Technique (BWO), Whale Optimization (WO), Atom Search optimization (ASO) etc., techniques that have the advantages of being adaptable to changing situations and having the capacity to handle intricate nonlinear systems. This also covers the optimization approaches used to maintain the best possible power quality while introducing intermittent renewable energy sources and energy storage systems into power networks. Overall, this analysis offers insightful information about the many optimization strategies applied to improve power quality in electrical systems.

articleTitle: A Model for Content-Based Image Retrieval Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Circuits, Power and Intelligent Systems (CCPIS)
abstract: With the value of digital data increasing in recent years, substantial improvements have been made in image processing. It is now simpler to produce large image datasets. picture processing is carrying out a variety of processes to improve a picture or extract informative data from it. With several theories and models relating to the retrieval of images from the collection of images called datasets, it has developed into a crucial study subject within the disciplines of engineering and computer science. A well-liked paradigm for the retrieval of images, image retrieval based on content is quicker and more advantageous than textual indexation. The authors of this study provide a paradigm for feature-based picture retrieval. Based on a user query, the model searches a database for the most relevant photographs and presents them with the least amount of vector distance. The suggested model can greatly enhance image retrieval systems and the applications of such systems in numerous sectors. Overall, this study makes a positive contribution to attempts to advance image processing technologies and their usefulness in the contemporary world.

articleTitle: Phishing Website Detection Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Circuits, Power and Intelligent Systems (CCPIS)
abstract: Phishing is a common tactic employed to deceive unsuspecting individuals into revealing their personal information through fraudulent websites. These phishing websites often steal passwords, usernames, and sensitive data related to online financial transactions. Phishers create websites that mimic the appearance and language of legitimate web pages to trick their targets. To combat the evolving techniques used in phishing attacks, it is crucial to implement antiphishing measures that can detect such attempts. Machine learning can play a significant role in stopping phishing attacks. This proposal presents a compilation of features and machine learningbased algorithms for identifying phishing attempts. Attackers frequently resort to phishing because it is easier to trick victims into clicking on seemingly legitimate yet malicious links, compared to circumventing computer security protocols. By replicating the official website's logo and other elements, the malicious link in the message body gives the impression of being affiliated with the legitimate website. This proposal explores the distinguishing characteristics of phishing domains, also known as scam domains, and emphasizes the importance of identifying them. Additionally, it discusses machine learning and natural language processing techniques that can be employed to achieve this goal.

articleTitle: Smart Electricity System Enabled By AI
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Circuits, Power and Intelligent Systems (CCPIS)
abstract: The 6G-enabled net of Things (IoT) has recently gained traction, resolution a range of period of time application considerations. AI is vital in huge knowledge analytics as a result of it provides reliable data analysis in real time. However, there are important concerns concerning security, privacy, the coaching data, and a centralized design once mistreatment artificial intelligence to develop the big data analysis. The combination of artificial intelligence with blockchain for IoT applications is bestowed during this article, that proposes a blockchain-based IoT framework with artificial intelligence. The planned architecture’ performance is assessed using each qualitative and quantitative metrics. The outline of AI centered B.C. and BC destined AI is employed to quantify however the combination of blockchain and AI tackles specific difficulties. The planned AI-BC architecture’ performance is assessed and compared to existing qualitative activity approaches. The instructed framework outperforms existing progressive methodologies, per the results of the experiments.

articleTitle: Maximizing Energy Savings in Electric Vehicles: A Route-Informed Elevation-Dependent Cruise Control Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Circuits, Power and Intelligent Systems (CCPIS)
abstract: Electric vehicles have been proposed as the most efficient method of dealing with the energy crisis and reducing air pollution. This paper uses an elevation-predictive cruise controller for electric vehicles to enhance energy efficiency and battery life. Route information is used to reduce energy consumption, maintain battery health, and plan speed. In order to facilitate real-time implementation, the specified route and develop a uniform nonlinear model are implemented to elevation framing. It also demonstrates the energy-saving potential of elevation-dependent motion control. In conclusion, the test vehicle achieved an energy gain of 1.08%(50508 Wh/51053 Wh).

articleTitle: Real-Time Traffic Analysis and Driver Safety Enhancement via IoT and Computer Vision with High-Resolution Project Lamps for Intelligent Road Illumination
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Circuits, Power and Intelligent Systems (CCPIS)
abstract: The research proposes improving night-time driving safety by handling high-resolution car projector lights. Internet of Things (IoT) and Computer Vision technology are employed in this strategy. The technology constantly monitors traffic data to adjust the light output and leave room for incoming traffic to prevent accidents. The proposed approach integrates computer vision, IoT, and high-resolution projection lighting to enhance traffic safety and lower the likelihood of accidents. The system will be managed by the You Only Look Once (YOLO) algorithm to adjust the light projection in response to the presence of other cars on the road, and the suggested method will automatically change the vehicle's high beam to prevent shining into the path of approaching traffic. The proposed architecture has the potential to significantly enhance night-time driving security, decreasing the danger of harm or death and significantly cutting the frequency of crashes.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Quantum Binary Adder-Subtractor Using IBM Qiskit
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Circuits, Power and Intelligent Systems (CCPIS)
abstract: In this paper, an n-bit Quantum Binary Adder-Subtractor (QBAS) is designed using quantum logic gates using IBM Qiskit. A comprehensive understanding of the principles of quantum computing and quantum logic gates is also provided. As the fundamental module of a binary adder-subtractor circuit is a full adder, various designs of quantum full adders (QFAs) from the literature are investigated on various aspects to deliberately choose the best quantum full adder suitable for QBAS application. A QBAS circuit is thus designed using the selected QFA, analyzed and tested for its ability to replicate the output of its classical counterpart. The results obtained here will aid researchers in the design of Quantum Arithmetic Logic Units (QALUs), Quantum multipliers, dividers, and other scalable adder circuits. The proposed circuits and its results shown here expected to pave the way for design of compact and state of the art quantum adders with reduced number of qubits, quantum cost.

articleTitle: Hybrid Harmony Search Based D-TIF Controller for Load Frequency Control of Multi Area Power System
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Circuits, Power and Intelligent Systems (CCPIS)
abstract: The focus of the current effort is load frequency control (LFC), which aims to supply consumers with high-quality power with little variation in frequency and tie line power. Strong intelligent control mechanisms have been used to fine-tune the parameters of the suggested derivative with tilt integral filter controller (D-TIF) in order to achieve this goal. An illustrative and practical solution for the LFC of two area-interconnected power systems is obtained using a novel optimization technique known as the hybrid harmony search differential evolution algorithm (HHSDE). Workable models for the investigated power systems include nonlinearities such generator rate limitations, boiler dynamics, and governor dead band (GDB). In comparison to other current traditional systems like the proportional-derivative-integral (PID) controller and the tilt-integral-derivative (TID) controller, the recommended D-TIF controllers are more resilient. In terms of peak overshoot, integral time square error (ITSE), and settling time, the preferred D-TIF controller provides a better dynamic response. By contrasting the HHSDE algorithm with other algorithms that have been reported in the literature, its efficacy is demonstrated. To test the HHSDE algorithm's capabilities, the robust and penetrative behaviour of the upset power system is also examined.

articleTitle: Advancements in Breast Cancer Detection: A Comprehensive Review of Deep Learning Techniques for Mammogram Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 1st International Conference on Circuits, Power and Intelligent Systems (CCPIS)
abstract: Biomedical advances in breast cancer detection are playing an important role in reducing the global death rate. Early and accurate identification of breast cancer not only increases life expectancy for patients but also fostering a paradigm shift to medical care and cancer management. Mammography is the primary screening tool for breast cancer, offering non-invasive imaging of breast tissue to identify potential abnormalities. However, mammogram interpretation is challenging due to its complex nature, and the risk of false negatives and false positives remains a significant concern. In recent years, learning-based methods have revolutionized mammogram analysis, showing tremendous potential in early breast cancer detection. This review paper presents a comprehensive analysis of various learning-based network architectures used for breast cancer detection and classification. Some models are very accurate, almost perfect, like ResNet18, VGG-16, and Inception V4. Some models may not be as accurate but are still useful, like RESNET-50 and MobileNet. The paper will also compare the strengths and limitations of these architectures, emphasizing the need for careful selection and potential combination of their best features to design more effective and robust models.
